categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao Kute Intelligent Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the customized apparel industry, focusing on large-scale personalized customization through its C2M (Customer-to-Manufactory) industrial internet platform. The company also engages in enterprise management consulting, internet technology development services, and battery manufacturing and sales. Its business model integrates R&D, design, raw material procurement, production, and logistics to provide end-to-end personalized apparel solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages its proprietary AI-driven enterprise-level operating system called Kute AI Agent, which enables data-driven, rule-based, and autonomous management of production and operations. It utilizes advanced manufacturing execution systems (MES), warehouse management systems (WMS), advanced planning and scheduling (APS), and supply chain management (SCM) systems. The production method emphasizes industrialized efficiency in personalized manufacturing, achieving 'one person, one pattern, one garment, one flow' with a 7-day delivery cycle, supported by intelligent measurement and matching systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kute Intelligent serves B-end customers including domestic and international clothing brand merchants, fashion designers, and apparel operators with their own stores and brands. The company also targets C-end consumers globally by offering high-quality, cost-effective personalized apparel products. Its markets include mid-to-high-end personalized apparel consumers, with a growing focus on women's customized clothing and expansion into multiple apparel categories.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Qingdao and Weifang, Shandong Province. It also has subsidiaries and sales operations in Hong Kong, Beijing, and New York, serving both domestic and international markets. Domestic sales accounted for approximately 57% of revenue, while overseas markets contributed about 43%, showing growth in international sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kute Intelligent operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the apparel supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and personalized production. It controls its own factories and integrates upstream raw material procurement through a consignment model with suppliers, and downstream sales through direct, franchise, and online channels. The company also provides digital supply chain management and enterprise-level operational systems to optimize the entire production and delivery process.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment in AI-driven industrial internet platforms, intelligent manufacturing, and digital transformation. Key projects include upgrading the C2M industrial internet platform, constructing a smart apparel trial factory, and developing a proprietary AI large model to enhance production efficiency, product quality, and cost reduction. Strategic collaboration with Huawei Cloud aims to advance the AI Agent operating system and expand cross-industry and cross-category replication capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized apparel products via direct sales, franchise stores, and online platforms. The company also earns income from management consulting and technology services. Its C2M platform enables demand-driven production, minimizing inventory and reducing costs, thus enhancing profitability. Additionally, investment income from equity method accounting and financial products contributes to non-operating revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kute Intelligent holds a leading position in the personalized apparel customization sector in China, distinguished by its advanced AI-driven manufacturing and digital governance systems. It has a first-mover advantage with a mature C2M platform and extensive industry standards participation. The company faces competition from traditional apparel manufacturers entering customization and other emerging personalized apparel providers but maintains competitive edges through technology, supply chain integration, and rapid delivery.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 708.6 million, a 5.14% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 88.6 million, down 20.71%. Domestic revenue declined by 14.14%, while overseas revenue grew by 10.15%. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.57 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.26 billion, with a weighted average return on equity of 7.25%. Despite short-term revenue pressure, the company continues to invest heavily in R&D and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kute Intelligent offers large-scale personalized apparel customization that combines industrialized production efficiency with individualized design, breaking the traditional conflict between personalization and mass production. Its AI-powered enterprise operating system enables real-time data-driven management, reducing costs and improving delivery speed to 7 days. The company provides extensive fabric and accessory options, supports customer interactive design, and maintains strong supplier relationships to ensure quality and flexibility. Its unique C2M platform and digital governance system deliver superior customer satisfaction and operational autonomy.
